class.name: com.simplysoftware.QuartzScheduler.QuartzScheduler
class.event: JobError (JobName As String, Error As String)
JobExecute (JobName As String, Data As Map)

method.name: JobExists
method.comment: Checks whether a job with the given name exists in any group. jobName is the Job name. Returns true if the job exists, false otherwise.

method.name: PauseJob
method.comment: Pauses a job by name in any group on a background thread. jobName is the Job name.

method.name: WatchdogStatus
method.comment: Logs a watchdog snapshot of scheduler and executor health.

method.name: GetLog
method.comment: Returns the full internal log of the scheduler. Returns a List of strings.

method.name: GetSchedulerState
method.comment: Returns a B4J Map with scheduler metadata: started(boolean), inStandby(boolean), shutdown(boolean)

method.name: GetNextFireTime
method.comment: Returns the next fire time for a given job (by name) as a Date, or Null if not found. Searches across all groups for the job name.

method.name: ListGroups
method.comment: Returns all job groups currently registered in the scheduler. Returns A List of group names.

method.name: DeleteGroup
method.comment: Deletes all jobs in a given group on a background thread. groupName is the Group name.

method.name: StopAsync
method.comment: Stop the scheduler completely. Deletes all scheduled jobs, shuts down Quartz, clears internal state, and destroys the instance.

method.name: SetJobChain
method.comment: Define a simple chain of jobs: JobNames(0) -> JobNames(1) -> JobNames(2) ... When one finishes successfully, the next is triggered. jobNames is the List of job names in execution order.

method.name: ScheduleRepeatingJob
method.comment: Schedule a repeating job (default group) on a background thread. jobName is the Job name. intervalSeconds is the Interval in seconds. repeatCount Number of repeats, zero or less means repeat forever. data is the Map data.

method.name: ResumeGroup
method.comment: Resumes all jobs in a given group on a background thread. groupName is the Group name.

method.name: ScheduleJobAsync
method.comment: Schedule job asynchronously on background thread (default group). jobName is the Job name. cronOrNull is the Cron expression or null. intervalSeconds is the Interval seconds for repeating (ignored if cron provided). repeatCount is the Repeat count for repeating (ignored if cron provided). data is the Map data.

method.name: GetJobData
method.comment: Retrieves the Map of data associated with a job. jobName is the Job name. Returns a Map of job data (empty if job not found).

method.name: IsStarted
method.comment: Returns true if the scheduler is started and not shutdown.

method.name: CancelJob
method.comment: Alias for PauseJob. jobName is the Job name.

method.name: CheckExecutorHealth
method.comment: Checks if the executor is alive and not shutdown. Raises event: ExecutorHealth (Boolean)

method.name: DeleteJob
method.comment: Deletes a job by name in any group on a background thread. jobName is the Job name.

method.name: ClearLog
method.comment: Clears the internal log entries.

method.name: ScheduleJobAsync2
method.comment: Schedule job asynchronously on background thread with group. jobName is the Job name. groupName is the Group name. cronOrNull is the Cron expression or null. intervalSeconds is the Interval seconds for repeating (ignored if cron provided). repeatCount is the Repeat count for repeating (ignored if cron provided). data is the Map data.

method.name: GetJobNames
method.comment: Returns a list of job names for a given group.

method.name: PauseGroup
method.comment: Pauses all jobs in a given group on a background thread. groupName is the Group name.

method.name: GetJobDetailInfo
method.comment: Returns basic job detail metadata as Map: Name, Group, Description. jobName is the Job name. Returns a Map with keys "Name", "Group", "Description" (empty if job not found).

method.name: GetJobLog
method.comment: Returns logs related to a specific job name. jobName is the Job name. Returns a List of strings.

method.name: ScheduleRepeatingJob2
method.comment: Schedule a repeating job with group on a background thread. jobName is the Job name. groupName is the Group name. intervalSeconds is the Interval in seconds. repeatCount Number of repeats, zero or less means repeat forever. data is the Map data.

method.name: GetJobGroups
method.comment: Returns a list of job group names.

method.name: GetTriggerInfo
method.comment: Returns detailed trigger information for a specific job. Each item in the returned list is a Map containing trigger metadata. jobName is the job name. Returns A List of Maps describing the job's triggers.

method.name: ShutdownAsync
method.comment: Shutdown scheduler on background thread. Returns immediately.

method.name: ResumeJob
method.comment: Resumes a previously paused job by name in any group on a background thread. jobName is the Job name.

method.name: ScheduleCronJob
method.comment: Schedule a cron job (default group) on a background thread. jobName is the Job name (unique). cron is the Cron expression. data is the Map of data to pass to job (can be null).

method.name: RunJobNow
method.comment: Run a job immediately by name (helper used by chaining).

method.name: StartAsync
method.comment: Start the scheduler on a background thread. The call returns immediately without waiting for the scheduler to start.

method.name: ScheduleCronJob2
method.comment: Schedule a cron job with group on a background thread. jobName is the Job name. groupName is the Group name. cron is the Cron expression. data is the Map data.

method.name: GetNextRunTime
method.comment: Returns the next scheduled execution time for a job. jobName is the Job name. Returns Next run time in milliseconds (0 if not found or no upcoming run).

method.name: GetJobState
method.comment: Returns the current state of a job. Possible values: SCHEDULED, PAUSED, RUNNING, COMPLETE, NOT_FOUND. jobName The job name. Returns State string.

method.name: InitializeAsync
method.comment: Initialise asynchronously, Uses RAMJobStore. eventName is the Event name prefix ("QS", "Quartz", "Schedule" etc).

method.name: InterruptJob
method.comment: Requests interruption of a running job on a background thread. jobName is the Job name.

method.name: GetAllJobs
method.comment: Returns a B4J List of all job names across all groups. Each item is a Map with keys: "group" and "name".

method.name: ListJobs
method.comment: Returns a List of job names currently known to the scheduler.

method.name: GetLogs
method.comment: Returns a copy of the internal log entries as a B4J List. The returned list contains the log lines in chronological order (oldest first).

method.name: GetLogCount
method.comment: Returns the number of log entries currently stored.

field.name: SetMaxLogEntries
field.comment: Sets the maximum number of log entries to retain. Default entries is set to 1000. Older entries are removed automatically.
